title: Great habit tracking app
body: Have tested many of those - Strides is one of the best. Especially with the Apple Health integration. The only improvement that I'd like to have is to have the option to use a timer: when you set a goal in minutes and can turn on/off the timer right inside the app manually. And one more ask - please keep improving the Apple Watch app as well - it is critical for efficiency of habit tracking imho. Thank you!
author: YuriAppS
